title: SMTP Email Service State
description: Sends mail. Addressed by its configuration, or by whatever the pass is carrying. (Runtimes: node; IDs: smtp-email)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

password.description: Write-only: never echoed back. passwordConfigured says whether one is set

from.description: Sender address; envelope mode may override it per message

subject.description: Subject — configured mode only, and the fallback in envelope mode

allowedRecipients.description: Addresses or @domains this may send to. Empty = unrestricted
